findings.title: Surface and traction analogy
findings.claim: Exploratorily, the focus stages a material communication struggle: disclosure reaches a surface, denial covers it, dispute twists an unstable counter-structure, and the operation seeks to remove traction from coherent truth.
findings.mechanism: The attributed outlier trace joins the supplied surface, covering, tight-twist, unstable-material, slipping, and tight-construction facets through the focus instrumental-purpose grammar.
findings.reader_payoff: The abstract contrast between true and false propositions becomes newly perceptible as a scene of reception, covering, construction, and attempted loss of footing.
findings.containment: This is an exploratory material analogy, not a lexical paraphrase or final interpretation; every branch is attributed to the exact focus trace and the primary contrast remains intact.

epistemic.reason: The trace has exact focus word coordinates and supplied facets, while its own packet qualification identifies it as exploratory and legacy_unbound.
